text: こおって　しまうと　まったく　うごけなく　なります！

structure.jp: こおって　しまうと
まったく　うごけなく　なります！
structure.en: it becomes completely unable to move!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-form verb says the thing happens completely, often as bad luck. こおって しまう = 'ends up frozen'.

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.span: うごけなく　なります
patterns.explanation: A 'not' form ending in なく plus なる says something stops being possible or stops happening. うごけなく なります = 'it becomes unable to move'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing always follows. こおって しまうと = 'if it ends up frozen'.
